reasoning_summary: The bug occurs because the calculation of the numerical mean in the HypergeometricDistribution class performs multiplication of two large integers before casting to a double. This causes an integer overflow when the product exceeds the maximum value of a 32-bit signed integer. The fix changes the order of operations to perform division first (by casting one operand to double), which ensures the intermediate calculation is performed in floating-point arithmetic, thus avoiding the overflow.
